risks: The frozen expectation tables (29/38/47, 21/30/39, the 12 resource limits and the quality threshold tokens) live in tools/verify_v1_plan.py. If the authority later changes a denominator or a threshold, the checker must be re-frozen by its owner in the same commit; this worker did not change any of them.

The quality-threshold check reads Chinese threshold tokens out of the acceptance-case assertion text. If Codex rewrites that wording without changing the numbers, the check reports E_QUALITY_DRIFT and needs a coordinated re-freeze.

The spec-manifest fence makes the checker fail closed whenever an authority file changes before the manifest is re-frozen. That is the intended 'spec drift' hard stop, but it means the checker is only valid against a fence-consistent tree.

jsonschema happens to be importable in this environment, so the metaschema path was exercised; on a host without it only the structural candidate-schema check runs and the tool reports E_SCHEMA_META_SKIPPED as a note, never as a silent pass.
Self-tests are not an independent review. The D0-B-REVIEW window and the Codex gate owner still have to accept the design; this worker claims READY_FOR_REVIEW only.

The checker validates plan structure and frozen hashes. It does not and cannot validate real product behaviour, sample annotation hashes, quality thresholds in practice, or any human experience signature.
